name.value: North Delta Centre for the Arts

description.value: North Delta Centre for the Arts is a municipal arts facility operated by the City of Delta, located in the North Delta neighbourhood. It serves the local community as a venue for arts and cultural programming. Touring cyclists exploring the Fraser Delta region may find it a worthwhile cultural stop.
